UK backs eight robotics adoption hubs with £40 million

The hubs offer advice, demonstrations and investment preparation across multiple sectors.

GOV.UK ↗9 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Support before adoption

The UK government announced £40 million for eight Robotics Adoption Hubs, helping businesses and public services identify suitable applications and practical adoption steps.

Testing before investment

Coverage includes SHARP surgical robotics, HARVEST agri-food, waste, manufacturing and public spaces. Services include independent guidance, demonstrations and feasibility assessments.

Preparing people and systems

Hubs will connect users with suppliers, integrators and finance providers. Productivity and patient-recovery benefits remain programme objectives rather than outcomes demonstrated by this announcement.
